interface.shortDescription: Choose context, model, and reasoning for complex work.
interface.longDescription: A thin adaptive-task-routing skill coordinates two independent context and model routers before substantial work and when improvement plans propose a next phase. Model and effort results remain visible, including unknown or retained settings. The default ask mode pauses only for recommended changes, while per-operation capability snapshots allow verified automation and accurate user fallbacks.
defaultPrompt: Use adaptive task routing before the next substantial phase.

plugin.description: Route complex work to an appropriate conversation context, model, and reasoning effort using shared runtime capability detection and independent user controls.

skills.name: adaptive-task-routing:adaptive-task-routing
skills.description: Coordinate context, model, and reasoning recommendations before substantial multi-step work, including coding, debugging, architecture, research, and analysis. Use after a rough plan forms, when an improvement plan proposes substantial next work, or at a meaningful phase transition. Skip brief explanations, status checks, tiny edits, and questions merely about this plugin.

skills.name: adaptive-task-routing:research-model-router
skills.description: Recommend model and reasoning effort for substantial coding, debugging, architecture, validation, research, or analysis. Use after context and rough plan are known, when an improvement plan proposes a substantial next phase, and at meaningful phase transitions. Skip ordinary chat and tiny operations; do not choose the working context.

skills.name: adaptive-task-routing:task-context-router
skills.description: Decide whether a non-trivial task should continue in the current conversation, move to a new context with a compact handoff, or start clean. Use after understanding the request and before context-heavy execution; do not use it to choose a model or reasoning effort.

claude.scope: plugin and Skill inventory discovery, not behavioral execution
